# `try_multiply`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
try_multiply(expr1, expr2)
```

Returns `expr1`*`expr2` and the result is null on overflow. The acceptable input types are the same with the `*` operator.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT try_multiply(2, 3);
```

Result:

```text
6
```

```sql
SELECT try_multiply(-2147483648, 10);
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```

```sql
SELECT try_multiply(interval 2 year, 3);
```

Result:

```text
6-0
```
